name: Base Game Family Home
author: TheClumsySimmer
style: Two-storey sage-yellow lap-siding Victorian-farmhouse family home on a raised foundation: hipped roof with two overlapping street gables, a one-storey gabled west wing, a gabled entry portico and a picket-railed wrap veranda, slate-blue louvred shutters and flower boxes on every window, a warm cream wainscoted living room with a canted garden bay, and a backyard homestead (lily pond with a gazebo on a boardwalk, glass greenhouse, staggered raised beds, monkey bars)
